title: The Human Digestive System: A Guided Journey

cues.text: Welcome aboard. We are going to follow a meal all the way through the digestive system. At each of nine stops, predict what happens, explain it in your own words, then see what really goes on.
Our first stop: the salivary glands. Look around, then press watch to see what happens here.
Stop 2: the mouth. Look around, then press watch to see what happens here.
Stop 3: the oesophagus. Look around, then press watch to see what happens here.
Stop 4: the stomach. Look around, then press watch to see what happens here.
Stop 5: the liver. Look around, then press watch to see what happens here.
Stop 6: the pancreas. Look around, then press watch to see what happens here.
Stop 7: the small intestine. Look around, then press watch to see what happens here.
Stop 8: the villi. Look around, then press watch to see what happens here.
Our last stop: the large intestine. Look around, then press watch to see what happens here.
That's the end of the journey. Now let's see what you remember. Answer each question, then check it.
Not quite, and that's fine. Read the feedback, then think back to what you saw at that stop.
Last step. Explain the whole journey in your own words. You can speak it or type it.
Well done, you have finished the journey. Look at your feedback to see what you explained well and what to revisit.
